## TemplateEngine.\_validateMediaGroupItems() method

Validates `<g-media>` items inside `<g-media-group>` blocks.

**Signature:**

```typescript
static _validateMediaGroupItems(template: string): Array<{
        line: number;
        message: string;
    }>;
```

## Remarks

Enforces the Telegram `sendMediaGroup` constraints: every item needs a supported `type` (`photo`<!-- -->, `video`<!-- -->, `audio`<!-- -->, `document`<!-- -->) and a `src`<!-- -->; groups need 1–[TemplateEngine.MAX\_MEDIA\_GROUP\_ITEMS](./gramstax.templateengine.max_media_group_items.md) items; `audio` and `document` items cannot mix with other types. Called by [TemplateEngine.validateBlockGMediaGroupAttributes()](./gramstax.templateengine.validateblockgmediagroupattributes.md)<!-- -->; errors carry 1-based line numbers.
